violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by (dishes). PIC relocated dishes to 3-bay sink to be washed, rinsed and sanitize. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/23/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 12/10/2025
The condensate from the ice machine unit is draining into a container. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. New Violation. Correct By: 12/17/2025
The door to the toilet room is not self-closing. Toilet rooms must be self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 12/17/2025
